integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a fast low tracking shot with small amplitude at fast speed frames the interior of a small convenience store at night; behind the checkout counter a young male clerk with slightly messy short black hair and a dark blue work jacket keeps his gaze lowered toward the marble counter top, his left hand lying flat on the surface and his right hand resting beside a black handheld barcode scanner that sits on the counter in its fixed place, and the glass storefront door in the background stays fully closed with the dark night street beyond the glass; no cat is visible in the frame. At 00:00.500, the glass door is pushed further open and the night outside throws a thin rim of cold light along the cat's back and tail as it breaks into a straight-line sprint down the aisle toward the checkout counter, claws ticking fast on the tile, the camera tracking with it and staying tight on the moving animal. At 00:01.700, the cat reaches the counter and springs up, and at 00:02.300 its four paws land flat on the counter top next to a black handheld barcode scanner sitting in its fixed cradle on the counter surface, the claws pulling in and the tail dropping low and flat against the counter. At 00:03.000, the clerk's right hand lifts off the counter and comes to a stop hanging in the air above the marble surface, the fingers open and motionless, the clerk's body gone rigid behind it. The shot settles on the landed cat, the scanner in its fixed place, and the frozen hand still suspended above the counter.
